title: Flirty Beta – Beta Minecraft Lighting
description: Resource pack brings Beta Minecraft lighting to modern versions.
body:
# Flirty Beta Flirty Beta brings back Beta Minecraft lighting into modern versions of the game. **DISABLE SMOOTH LIGHTING FOR BEST EXPERIENCE**
## Download Check out the [releases](https://github.com/Blobosle/flirty-beta/releases) to download the resource pack for your Minecraft version. ## Support If you want to support me, you can do so by giving the repository a [star](https://github.com/Blobosle/flirty-beta) on GitHub. It's free, and I would greatly appreciate it!
